verdict.rationale: Zero explicitly markets itself as an open-source, self-hostable email app that integrates with external providers like Gmail, giving switchers control over the mail pipeline (zero-gh-2, zero-gh-6, zero-gh-8, zero-gh-13, zero-gh-16), and ROADMAP.md lists ongoing self-hosting capabilities work (zero-docs-15). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a full self-hosting deployment/setup guide and confirmation that the mail pipeline (not just the client) can be fully run under one's own control rather than depending on third-party provider APIs.
